_comment: #330/#367/#384/#367b/#399/#401/#401a/#401b truck & minimal-change leveling rules. Truck times per supplier: data/suppliers.csv (match, trucks = SRM slot names, mail, to_env, cc_env[, max_carts]) - not in git because of the supplier names. pm_additional_days: 'next_run_day', 'tomorrow' or 'all'. run_days: 'MonSat' or 'Daily'. leveling: enabled (bool), freeze_departed (bool, code default true; false levels every truck of the day in all runs), safety_margin (float >= 0.10, default 0.15 -> 115%), freeze_lead_min (default 30, used when freeze_departed=true), overload_factor (float > 1.0, default 1.7 for suppliers without a cap), max_carts_per_truck (schedule/supplier key -> int cap; capped suppliers fill trucks <= cap at 115% then 100% fallback and push remaining > cap overflow to the last truck while keeping >= 100% coverage, emitting 'Extra truck needed' warnings).
